claims.quote: ["lambda",["a"],"a"] takes 1 argument but got 3.

says.lion: a call refused when a lambda is given more arguments than it has parameters

claims.where: program cl-arity.json: a lambda of one parameter given three arguments

claims.quote: ["lambda",["a"],"a"] takes 1 argument but got 3.

says.lion: a lambda ignores extra arguments

claims.where: program cl-arity.json: a lambda of one parameter given three arguments

claims.quote: ["lambda",["a","b"],"a"] takes 2 arguments but got 1.

says.lion: a lambda given the wrong number of arguments fails as a library function does

claims.where: program cl-arity-fewer.json: the message has the form of "console/log" takes 1 argument but got 2. (cl-arity-library.json), where it said before that a lambda was called with fewer arguments than it has parameters

claims.quote: There is no key "b" in {"a":1}.

says.lion: plain code that tells a missing key from a key holding null

claims.where: program cl-missing-key.json: object/get of a key that is not there, which gave null before

claims.quote: No case of the match fits "x", and it has no fallback

says.lion: a match always has a fallback

claims.where: program cl-match-fallback.json: a match with one case and no fallback, which was refused before as not a well-formed match form

claims.quote: set! cannot change "calls" while a rule, query, or find runs

claims.quote: set! cannot change "calls" while a rule, query, or find runs

says.lion: a function that changes a binding gives in a rule body what it gives in plain code

claims.where: program cl-effect-in-rule.json: the counter numbers three items when array/map calls it in plain code, and fails when a rule body calls it, where it gave one number for all three before

claims.quote: "number/add" takes a number as argument 1 but got "seven". (in "next", called from "label")

says.lion: a failure that names the function given a wrong argument

claims.where: program cl-contract.json: "seven" passed through two lambdas to number/add; it names the function and the functions the failure left, where it said Expected number at [0] before

claims.quote: The integer 9007199254740993 at line 3, column 50 cannot be held exactly

says.lion: an integer refused when it cannot be held exactly

claims.where: program cl-big-integers.json: an integer written one past two to the 53rd, refused when the program's text is read

claims.quote: a JSON number holds every integer only from -9007199254740991 to 9007199254740991

says.lion: integers kept exact past two to the 53rd

claims.where: program cl-big-integers.json: an integer past that range is refused, not kept exact

claims.quote: "what why gives for a proof whose premises contradict each other": "absent, certificate, contradicting"

says.lion: which assumptions make a goal unsatisfiable

claims.where: program cl-why-absent.json: the keys of why's reason for a rule proved from premises that contradict each other, which were only absent before

claims.quote: "what why gives for a proof whose premises contradict each other": "absent, certificate, contradicting"

says.lion: a proof that says when its premises allow no state

claims.where: program cl-why-absent.json: why names the contradicting premises; the proof itself still holds, as cl-vacuous-proof.json shows

claims.quote: undefined

says.lion: values computed on first demand and kept

claims.where: program cl-no-delay.json: ["delay", ["number/add", 1, 2]] is no longer refused as not a call; it gives a promise, which has no JSON form, so the CLI at this commit wrote undefined (cl-built-promise.json forces one)

claims.quote: quantity/add: 120 {"m":1} and 8 {"s":1} have different units.

says.lion: quantities whose units are checked when they are combined

claims.where: program cl-built-units.json: the length and the time cl-units.json added as numbers, added as quantities

claims.quote: "times the body ran before it was forced": 0

says.lion: values computed on first demand and kept

claims.where: program cl-built-promise.json: a delay whose body counts its runs, before value/force

claims.quote: "times the body ran": 1

says.lion: values computed on first demand and kept

claims.where: program cl-built-promise.json: after value/force twice, each giving 42

claims.quote: "failure": "LogicError"

says.lion: a failure a program can catch and read as data

claims.where: program cl-built-catch.json: func/catch of number/add given "seven", whose handler gets the failure as a record of its kind and message

claims.quote: "a continuation kept and called after its reset gave it": 6

says.lion: first-class continuations

claims.where: program cl-built-shift.json: func/shift's handler gives k itself, func/reset gives it back as a value, and a call of it resumes the delimited part; delimited and one-shot, not call/cc, which cl-no-callcc.json still shows Lion lacks

claims.quote: A continuation was resumed a second time: the one func/shift gives goes on once.

says.lion: a continuation resumed more than once

claims.where: program cl-built-shift.json: a handler that calls k twice, under func/catch

claims.quote: "seven" does not fit "value/number?". (in "label")

says.lion: a lambda whose arguments are checked against schemas when it is called

claims.where: program cl-built-contract.json: next's parameter is ["n", "value/number?"], and label calls it with "seven"

claims.quote: "seven" does not fit "value/number?". (in "label")

says.lion: a failure that names the function and the caller that broke its contract

claims.where: program cl-built-contract.json: the failure names the caller, label, but not next, whose contract it broke

claims.quote: This case can never be reached: every value its schema allows fits the schema of case 1, which comes first.

says.lion: a report of a match case no value can reach

claims.where: lion check of cl-match-cases.json: the value/integer? case after the value/number? case, which the program, run, does not report

claims.quote: fits no case, and the match has no fallback.

says.lion: a match checked to cover every value of its schema

claims.where: lion check of cl-built-match-cover.json: a match with no fallback on a parameter whose contract allows a sale, a refund, or a void, with cases for a sale and a refund

claims.quote: told after a second order: {"added":[2],"removed":[1]}

says.lion: host code told when a derived value changes

claims.where: watch-host/watch.mjs: host code watches a find of a count a rule derives; a fact that changes no answer, and a fact after the watching stopped, tell nothing

claims.quote: Called with any other number, it fails as every function does

says.lion: a lambda ignores extra arguments

claims.quote: calls it through func/callback , which gives it as many as it takes.

says.lion: a match checked to cover every value of its schema
